process_steps.input_state: mixed elemental powders with 20-30 nm yttria

evidence.quote: Proportionally mixed powders were alloyed using a planetary ball mill in Ar gas atmosphere. Milling media were steel balls of 5 mm in diameter. ... Milling was done for 20 hrs at the B/P ratio of 15:1.
MA powders were hipped at 1150 oC under about 100 MPa (15,000 psi) for 4 hrs following the canning and degassing processes.
Hipped samples were hot rolled at 1150 oC, and then normalized at 1150 oC for 1 hr and tempered at 750 oC for 1 hr through air cooling respectively.
